title: Introduce interactional cohort echo detector CI hook and dynamic gating
author: Maya Patel
body: Motivation: Some prompt-set regressions we observe are caused by interactional echoes where repeated context or mirrored user/system fragments amplify apparent metric drift. This PR adds a lightweight CI hook that computes an "echo_ratio" per prompt cohort, compares it against a rolling historical baseline and flags abnormal increases as a gated quality signal. Summary of changes: 1) new CI hook implementation eval_harness/hooks/echo_detector.py; 2) unit and integration tests for synthetic echo probes; 3) small augmentation to the smoke-eval runner to emit cohort-level echo metrics; 4) CI workflow wiring and documentation. Behavior: the hook computes echo_ratio = (tokens_repeating_from_previous_turns / total_tokens) for each cohort and emits a cohort_echo_score. The gate decision uses a historical baseline computed as 30-day rolling median plus configurable MAD multiplier. On branch-level CI the gate is a soft-fail (comment + metadata) to avoid blocking iteration; on main it is hard-fail by default with an automatic cooldown window and suggested rollback URL. Backwards compatibility: no changes to existing eval result formats except the new optional field "cohort_metrics.echo_ratio". Checklist: [x] Implementation and tests added [x] Docs updated under docs/ci-hooks/echo-detector.md [x] Benchmarks and local run instructions included Local repro: python -m pytest tests/test_echo_detector.py --run-synthetic to run the synthetic probe. Operational notes: historical baselines are stored as artifacts under eval-artifacts/echo-baselines/<cohort>. The hook tolerates sparse history and falls back to absolute thresholds when history < 10 samples. Why unique: focuses on interaction-pattern artifacts (mirrored prompts, repeated prefixes) that often produce false-positive regressions for generation fluency metrics and are not captured by token-level confidence or semantic deltas alone. Requesting review for threshold defaults and rollout policy.
commits: 1) 9a3e5b2 Add core echo detector implementation and unit tests; 2) 4bcd1f0 Wire echo metrics into smoke-eval reporter; 3) 2f7c9d4 CI workflow: add echo-detector job and artifact upload; 4) d1a8b3e Docs: add runbook and troubleshooting notes
review_conversation: Evan Brooks: Nice direction. A couple of asks: please ensure the MAD multiplier is configurable per-repo and not hardcoded, and add a small benchmark for false positive rate on recent prompt-sets.

Maya Patel: Added config via eval_config['echo_detector'] and included a 5k-prompt synthetic benchmark in tests that exercises mirrored-prefix cases. See tests/test_echo_detector.py:bench_false_positive().
Liam Chen: The cooldown semantics look sensible but can we add an admin override flag in the console to mute alerts for scheduled experiments?
Maya Patel: Added support for an artifact-based mute list and documented admin_override boolean in docs. The CI path reads eval-artifacts/echo-detector/mute-list.txt if present.
Sofia Martinez: Minor nits on logging verbosity and suggested small refactor to keep the reporter agnostic to the hook. LGTM after those changes.
Evan Brooks: Approving; verified CI artifacts and baseline computation on the feature branch.
release_notes: Add interactional cohort echo detector CI hook. New metric: cohort_metrics.echo_ratio. Gate integrates with rolling historical baseline and supports soft-fail on feature branches and hard-fail on main. Added docs and runbook.
